messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — High_rate: datadog ingestion delay detected for logs and metrics in aws-us-east-1. Some dashboards failing to update.

maya: seeing it — several Grafana panels stuck at T-5m. paging ops oncall.

ops-sre: got page, joining. can anyone confirm if traces are affected or just metrics/logs?

alex: traces look ok for a subset, but APM events are delayed too. span search returning stale results.

jin: Datadog status shows 'ingestion backlog' for logs/metrics in US-EAST: https://status.datadoghq.com/incidents/abc123 (they posted at 10:13 UTC)

lisa-cs: customer note: @important-customer reported missing alerts in their production cluster ~10:10 UTC. CS triage opened.

oncall-bot: @ops oncall triggered (maya). Escalation level: P2.

maya: handing off to @ops-sre (alex) in 15m — I need to jump to a customer call. leaving summary below.

maya: summary: Datadog ingestion delay impacting logs/metrics in us-east-1, dashboards stale, alerts suppressed. partial traces delayed. customer impact: missing alerting runs and delayed incident detection for affected customers.

alex: thanks. immediate plan: 1) verify whether our Datadog API token calls are being rate-limited or errors 2) enable fallbacks: local alerting to PagerDuty via prometheus push where possible 3) inform NOC/CS and update status page.

ops-sre: running quick checks — curl to DD api shows 503 backlog on /api/v1/series for some requests.

ops-sre: command: ```bash
curl -s -H "DD-API-KEY: REDACTED" https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/series | jq '.errors'
```

alex: good call. also switching critical alerting to direct PagerDuty hook for key rules. will apply temporary override in rules engine.

jin: note: logs forwarded to our long-term s3 bucket still ingesting on our side; we can surface recent logs from there to CS for impacted customers. ETA for searchable logs ~10-15m to create temporary artifact.

lisa-cs: please create a short template for customer-facing message I can push to all affected accounts (only a handful so far). include ETA and mitigation steps.

alex: drafted message: "We are seeing delayed metrics and logs ingestion in Datadog impacting alerting and dashboards for us-east customers. Our engineering team has enabled failover alerting and is working with Datadog. We will provide updates every 15 minutes." Thoughts?

lisa-cs: perfect, send it. mark affected customers and include: "If you rely on Datadog alerts for automated actions, consider enabling our webhook fallback."

ops-sre: mitigation checklist (in order):
- flip critical rules to PD webhook
- enable Prometheus pushgateway scrape for services with local exporters
- create temporary Grafana snapshot for dashboards (static)
- surface raw logs from s3 to CS for manual inspection

maya: tagged docs/incidents/datadog-ingestion-delay for post-incident writeup. please add timing and decisions.

alex: Datadog replied on the incident thread: "We're processing backlog; no ETA yet. Workaround: throttling down non-critical ingestion helps." They asked if we can reduce non-critical traffic.

ops-sre: implementing rate-limits on verbose debug logs at ingestion point. patch rolling now to reduce log volume from non-prod clusters.

jin: monitoring check: dashboards started to show new points at 10:24 UTC for some metrics — partial recovery.

lisa-cs: CS update sent at 10:27 UTC to affected customers. Tone: transparent, we applied failover alerting, monitoring continues.

oncall-bot: handoff reminder — maya back in 10m to re-assume if needed.

maya: back. thanks @alex and team. what's the current impact scope?

ops-sre: current scope: ~us-east-1 metrics/logs; ~12% of production customers had delayed alerts; we've applied webhook fallback for the 5 highest-severity customers.

alex: recommend status page update and a brief note to SRE slack and PagerDuty ops with mitigation steps. also capture cost of additional webhook traffic for billing.

maya: agreed. I'll own the post-incident doc and CS timeline. assign action items: alex — update alert rules and record commands; jin — export S3 logs for the 3 affected accounts; lisa-cs — paste customer messages into the doc. ops-sre — list config changes for rollback.

ops-sre: will post change list. rollback: revert rate-limit patches and remove temporary webhooks when Datadog confirms back to normal.

incident-bot: Incident note created: DOC-1768234567 — Datadog ingestion delay (us-east-1). Severity: mitigated P2.

lisa-cs: tagging support queue with links to s3 artifacts for manual checks.

alex: will follow up in 30m with recovery confirmation. closing loop once Datadog clears backlog and all alerts restored.

maya: thanks everyone. small action: let's add a playbook item to detect vendor ingestion backlog quicker (maybe synthetic heartbeat on logs).

ops-sre: agreed — adding to backlog.

lisa-cs: closing the loop on CS — customers acknowledged and will monitor. :pray:
